beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Spring, eighteen twenty. Palmyra, New York. A fourteen-year-old farm boy is about to walk into the woods with one question — and end a seventeen-hundred-year famine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: His town was at war over religion. Camp meetings, rival preachers, every church claiming to be right. Joseph Smith wanted his sins forgiven and wanted to know where to go. And nobody's answer settled anything.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One verse in the book of James went through him like fire. Ask God. Not a preacher. Not a council. Ask the God who gives to everyone, generously — and never scolds you for asking.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So on the morning of a beautiful clear spring day, he walked into the grove of trees on his family's farm, found the place he had picked out, knelt down — and for the first time in his life, prayed out loud.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And the darkness came for him first. Remember whose kingdom that prayer threatened. A power seized him. It bound his tongue so he could not speak, and thick darkness gathered around him, until he thought he was finished.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: I saw a pillar of light exactly over my head, above the brightness of the sun; which descended gradually until it fell upon me.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: When the light rested upon me I saw two Personages, whose brightness and glory defy all description, standing above me in the air.

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: This is My Beloved Son. Hear Him!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Father — a real, glorified Person — calling a boy by name and pointing to His Son. The Son — the living, risen Jesus Christ — standing beside Him in the air. Every question the famine had starved for centuries: answered in ten seconds.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The boy asked his question, and got his answer: join none of them. The authority had left the earth centuries ago — and heaven was about to bring it back.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He walked out of those trees into a world that would hate him for it. He was fourteen — and he never took one word of it back. Years later, he wrote:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: I had actually seen a light, and in the midst of that light I saw two Personages, and they did in reality speak to me; and though I was hated and persecuted for saying that I had seen a vision, yet it was true. For I had seen a vision; I knew it, and I knew that God knew it, and I could not deny it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And the invitation he used was never his alone. It is still in the book. If any of you lack wisdom — ask. He answered a farm boy. He answers you.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: God answered a fourteen-year-old in the woods. The heavens are open. Ask.
